deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 我{{c1::是::link verb: to be (noun = noun)}}学生。
tr: I'm a student.
notes: A 是 B: A is B (it links two nouns). Negative: 不是.
tip: Adjectives don't take 是: 我很忙, not 我是忙.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 他{{c1::不是::negative: is not}}老师。
tr: He isn't a teacher.
notes: A 是 B: A is B (it links two nouns). Negative: 不是.
tip: Adjectives don't take 是: 我很忙, not 我是忙.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 这{{c1::是::link verb: to be}}我的书。
tr: This is my book.
notes: A 是 B: A is B (it links two nouns). Negative: 不是.
tip: Adjectives don't take 是: 我很忙, not 我是忙.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text:
我{{c1::是::是 or 很?}}中国人。
我{{c2::很::是 or 很?}}忙。
tr: I'm Chinese. / I'm busy.
notes: Before a noun: 是. Before an adjective: no 是; use 很 (which often just means 'is', not 'very').

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 今天{{c1::很::是 or 很?}}冷。
tr: It's cold today.
notes: Before a noun: 是. Before an adjective: no 是; use 很 (which often just means 'is', not 'very').

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 我{{c1::有::have}}一个哥哥。
tr: I have an older brother.
notes: 有: have; there is / are. The negative is always 没有 (never 不有).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 我{{c1::没有::don't have}}钱。
tr: I don't have any money.
notes: 有: have; there is / are. The negative is always 没有 (never 不有).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 桌子上{{c1::有::there is}}一本书。
tr: There's a book on the table.
notes: 有: have; there is / are. The negative is always 没有 (never 不有).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 你{{c1::有::have}}时间吗？
tr: Do you have time?
notes: 有: have; there is / are. The negative is always 没有 (never 不有).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 我妈妈{{c1::在::be at / in (location)}}家。
tr: My mum's at home.
notes: Person / thing + 在 + place: be at; be in.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 你{{c1::在::be at / in (location)}}哪儿？
tr: Where are you?
notes: Person / thing + 在 + place: be at; be in.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 医院{{c1::在::be located at}}学校前面。
tr: The hospital is in front of the school.
notes: Person / thing + 在 + place: be at; be in.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text:
我的书{{c1::在::在 or 有?}}桌子上。
桌子上{{c1::有::在 or 有?}}一本书。
tr: My book is on the table. / There's a book on the table.
notes: Known thing + 在 + place: where it is. Place + 有 + thing: what's there.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 学校里{{c1::有::在 or 有?}}很多学生。
tr: There are lots of students at the school.
notes: Known thing + 在 + place: where it is. Place + 有 + thing: what's there.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::01 是, 有 and 在
text: 小狗{{c1::在::在 or 有?}}门后面。
tr: The puppy is behind the door.
notes: Known thing + 在 + place: where it is. Place + 有 + thing: what's there.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Several of us) {{c1::我们::we}}是朋友。
tr: We're friends.
notes: 我 (I), 你 (you), 他 (he), 她 (she), 它 (it). Add 们 for the plural: 我们, 你们, 他们. 您: polite 'you'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Polite, to a teacher) {{c1::您::you (polite)}}好！
tr: Hello!
notes: 我 (I), 你 (you), 他 (he), 她 (she), 它 (it). Add 们 for the plural: 我们, 你们, 他们. 您: polite 'you'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (About a woman) {{c1::她::she}}是我的老师。
tr: She's my teacher.
notes: 我 (I), 你 (you), 他 (he), 她 (she), 它 (it). Add 们 for the plural: 我们, 你们, 他们. 您: polite 'you'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (About several men) {{c1::他们::they}}在学校。
tr: They're at school.
notes: 我 (I), 你 (you), 他 (he), 她 (she), 它 (it). Add 们 for the plural: 我们, 你们, 他们. 您: polite 'you'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Near me) {{c1::这::this}}是我的手机。
tr: This is my phone.
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Over there) {{c1::那::that}}是谁的车？
tr: Whose car is that?
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Near me) {{c1::这儿::here}}有一个饭店。
tr: There's a restaurant here.
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Over there) 他住在{{c1::那儿::there}}。
tr: He lives there.
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 你要{{c1::哪::which}}个？
tr: Which one do you want?
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: (Near me) 我想买{{c1::这::this}}本书。
tr: I want to buy this book.
notes: 这 (this), 那 (that), 哪 (which). 这儿 (here), 那儿 (there), 哪儿 (where). Before a noun, add a measure word: 这本书, 那个人.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 这是{{c1::我的::my (pronoun + 的)}}书。
tr: This is my book.
notes: Person / pronoun + 的 + noun: 's / of (我的书, 老师的电脑). With close family and your own institutions, 的 is often dropped (我妈妈, 我们学校).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 那是老师{{c1::的::possessive particle}}电脑。
tr: That's the teacher's computer.
notes: Person / pronoun + 的 + noun: 's / of (我的书, 老师的电脑). With close family and your own institutions, 的 is often dropped (我妈妈, 我们学校).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 这是谁{{c1::的::possessive particle}}杯子？
tr: Whose cup is this?
notes: Person / pronoun + 的 + noun: 's / of (我的书, 老师的电脑). With close family and your own institutions, 的 is often dropped (我妈妈, 我们学校).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 他是我{{c1::的::possessive particle}}朋友。
tr: He's my friend.
notes: Person / pronoun + 的 + noun: 's / of (我的书, 老师的电脑). With close family and your own institutions, 的 is often dropped (我妈妈, 我们学校).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text:
我{{c1::姓::姓 or 叫?}}李。
我{{c2::叫::姓 or 叫?}}李小红。
tr: My surname is Li. / My name is Li Xiaohong.
notes: 姓 + surname: be surnamed. 叫 + full name or given name: be called.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::02 Pronouns, 这 / 那, 的, 叫 / 姓
text: 你{{c1::叫::姓 or 叫?}}什么名字？
tr: What's your name?
notes: 姓 + surname: be surnamed. 叫 + full name or given name: be called.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 你是中国人{{c1::吗::question particle (yes/no)}}？
tr: Are you Chinese?
notes: Statement + 吗 = a yes / no question. The word order doesn't change.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 你喜欢喝茶{{c1::吗::question particle (yes/no)}}？
tr: Do you like tea?
notes: Statement + 吗 = a yes / no question. The word order doesn't change.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 他在家{{c1::吗::question particle (yes/no)}}？
tr: Is he at home?
notes: Statement + 吗 = a yes / no question. The word order doesn't change.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 你叫{{c1::什么::what}}名字？
tr: What's your name?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 他是{{c1::谁::who}}？
tr: Who is he?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 你家在{{c1::哪儿::where}}？
tr: Where's your home?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 这个字{{c1::怎么::how}}读？
tr: How do you read this character?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 今天天气{{c1::怎么样::how is it?}}？
tr: What's the weather like today?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 你{{c1::什么::what (+ 时候 = when)}}时候来？
tr: When are you coming?
notes: The question word goes where the answer would be (no change of word order): 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪儿 (where), 怎么 (how), 怎么样 (how is it), 什么时候 (when). No 吗 with a question word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text:
你有{{c1::几::几 or 多少?}}个孩子？
你们学校有{{c2::多少::几 or 多少?}}学生？
tr: How many children do you have? / How many students are there at your school?
notes: 几 + measure word: small numbers (usually under 10), dates and clock times. 多少: larger or unknown amounts; the measure word is optional; also prices (多少钱).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 这个{{c1::多少::几 or 多少?}}钱？
tr: How much is this?
notes: 几 + measure word: small numbers (usually under 10), dates and clock times. 多少: larger or unknown amounts; the measure word is optional; also prices (多少钱).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 现在{{c1::几::几 or 多少?}}点？
tr: What time is it?
notes: 几 + measure word: small numbers (usually under 10), dates and clock times. 多少: larger or unknown amounts; the measure word is optional; also prices (多少钱).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 今天{{c1::几::几 or 多少?}}号？
tr: What's the date today?
notes: 几 + measure word: small numbers (usually under 10), dates and clock times. 多少: larger or unknown amounts; the measure word is optional; also prices (多少钱).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 我很好，你{{c1::呢::what about …? (particle)}}？
tr: I'm fine — and you?
notes: Noun / pronoun + 呢: what about…? (a follow-up question). On its own after a thing: where is…?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 我是老师，他{{c1::呢::what about …? (particle)}}？
tr: I'm a teacher. What about him?
notes: Noun / pronoun + 呢: what about…? (a follow-up question). On its own after a thing: where is…?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::03 Questions
text: 我的手机{{c1::呢::where is …? (particle)}}？
tr: Where's my phone?
notes: Noun / pronoun + 呢: what about…? (a follow-up question). On its own after a thing: where is…?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我有三{{c1::本::measure word (books)}}书。
tr: I have three books.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我家有四{{c1::口::measure word (family members)}}人。
tr: There are four people in my family.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我要一{{c1::杯::measure word (cup)}}茶。
tr: I'd like a cup of tea.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 那{{c1::个::measure word (general)}}人是我爸爸。
tr: That man is my dad.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我女儿五{{c1::岁::measure word (years of age)}}。
tr: My daughter is five.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 这个苹果三{{c1::块::measure word (money: yuan, spoken)}}钱。
tr: This apple is three yuan.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我想买{{c1::一些::some (+ noun)}}水果。
tr: I'd like to buy some fruit.
notes: Number / 这 / 那 / 几 + measure word + noun. 个: general. 本: books. 口: family members. 杯: cups / glasses. 岁: years of age (no 是 needed). 块: yuan (spoken). 一些: some.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text:
我有{{c1::两::二 or 两?}}个妹妹。
我十{{c2::二::二 or 两?}}岁。
tr: I have two younger sisters. / I'm twelve.
notes: 两 before a measure word (两个, 两杯). 二 when counting, in dates and phone numbers, and inside larger numbers (十二, 二十).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我要{{c1::两::二 or 两?}}杯咖啡。
tr: I'd like two coffees.
notes: 两 before a measure word (两个, 两杯). 二 when counting, in dates and phone numbers, and inside larger numbers (十二, 二十).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: (Counting) 一，{{c1::二::二 or 两?}}，三。
tr: One, two, three.
notes: 两 before a measure word (两个, 两杯). 二 when counting, in dates and phone numbers, and inside larger numbers (十二, 二十).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 我们班有{{c1::二十::20}}个学生。
tr: There are twenty students in our class.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::04 Numbers and measure words
text: 这本书一{{c1::百::hundred}}块。
tr: This book costs a hundred yuan.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 今天是十月一{{c1::号::day of the month (spoken)}}。
tr: Today is 1 October.
notes: Dates go from biggest to smallest: 年 → 月 → 号 (spoken) / 日 (written). Days: 星期一 … 星期六, 星期天 / 星期日. 星期几: which day of the week?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 明天是{{c1::星期六::Saturday}}。
tr: Tomorrow is Saturday.
notes: Dates go from biggest to smallest: 年 → 月 → 号 (spoken) / 日 (written). Days: 星期一 … 星期六, 星期天 / 星期日. 星期几: which day of the week?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 今天{{c1::星期几::what day of the week?}}？
tr: What day is it today?
notes: Dates go from biggest to smallest: 年 → 月 → 号 (spoken) / 日 (written). Days: 星期一 … 星期六, 星期天 / 星期日. 星期几: which day of the week?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 我的生日是五{{c1::月::month}}八号。
tr: My birthday is 8 May.
notes: Dates go from biggest to smallest: 年 → 月 → 号 (spoken) / 日 (written). Days: 星期一 … 星期六, 星期天 / 星期日. 星期几: which day of the week?

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 现在八{{c1::点::o'clock}}。
tr: It's eight o'clock.
notes: 点 (o'clock), 分 (minutes), 半 (half past): 三点半, 八点十分.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 我七点{{c1::半::half past}}起床。
tr: I get up at half past seven.
notes: 点 (o'clock), 分 (minutes), 半 (half past): 三点半, 八点十分.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 电影三点二十{{c1::分::minutes}}开始。
tr: The film starts at three twenty.
notes: 点 (o'clock), 分 (minutes), 半 (half past): 三点半, 八点十分.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: {{c1::昨天::yesterday}}我去商店了。
tr: I went to the shop yesterday.
notes: 今天, 明天, 昨天, 现在; 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上. Time words go before the verb (at the start of the sentence or right after the subject), never at the end like in English.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 我{{c1::下午::afternoon}}有课。
tr: I have a class this afternoon.
notes: 今天, 明天, 昨天, 现在; 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上. Time words go before the verb (at the start of the sentence or right after the subject), never at the end like in English.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: {{c1::现在::now}}几点？
tr: What time is it now?
notes: 今天, 明天, 昨天, 现在; 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上. Time words go before the verb (at the start of the sentence or right after the subject), never at the end like in English.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 我们{{c1::晚上::evening}}看电视。
tr: We watch TV in the evening.
notes: 今天, 明天, 昨天, 现在; 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上. Time words go before the verb (at the start of the sentence or right after the subject), never at the end like in English.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::05 Dates and time
text: 你{{c1::什么时候::when}}回家？
tr: When are you going home?
notes: 今天, 明天, 昨天, 现在; 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上. Time words go before the verb (at the start of the sentence or right after the subject), never at the end like in English.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::06 Adverbs: 不 / 没, 很, 太…了, 也, 都
text:
我明天{{c1::不::不 or 没?}}去。
我昨天{{c2::没::不 or 没?}}去。
tr: I'm not going tomorrow. / I didn't go yesterday.
notes: 不: negates the present and future, habits, adjectives, 是 and modal verbs. 没 (有): negates the past or completed actions, and 有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::06 Adverbs: 不 / 没, 很, 太…了, 也, 都
text: 我{{c1::不::不 or 没?}}喜欢咖啡。
tr: I don't like coffee.
notes: 不: negates the present and future, habits, adjectives, 是 and modal verbs. 没 (有): negates the past or completed actions, and 有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::07 Modal verbs: 想, 要, 会, 能, 可以
text:

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::08 Place: 在 + place, location words

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::09 Particles: 了, 吧, 呢
text: 我买{{c1::了::completed action (after the verb)}}一本书。
tr: I bought a book.
notes: Verb + 了: a completed action (我买了一本书). 了 at the end of a sentence: a change or new situation (下雨了 = it's started raining). The negative uses 没 and drops 了 (我没买书).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::09 Particles: 了, 吧, 呢
text: 下雨{{c1::了::new situation (end of sentence)}}。
tr: It's started raining.
notes: Verb + 了: a completed action (我买了一本书). 了 at the end of a sentence: a change or new situation (下雨了 = it's started raining). The negative uses 没 and drops 了 (我没买书).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::09 Particles: 了, 吧, 呢
text: 我饿{{c1::了::new situation (end of sentence)}}。
tr: I'm hungry now.
notes: Verb + 了: a completed action (我买了一本书). 了 at the end of a sentence: a change or new situation (下雨了 = it's started raining). The negative uses 没 and drops 了 (我没买书).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::09 Particles: 了, 吧, 呢
text: 他已经走{{c1::了::completed / change (end of sentence)}}。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK1::09 Particles: 了, 吧, 呢

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在
text: 我去{{c1::过::experience (have done before)}}北京。

text: 你吃{{c1::过::experience (have done before)}}北京烤鸭吗？

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在
text: 我没看{{c1::过::experience (negative: 没 + verb + …)}}这个电影。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在
text:
(Experience, at some point) 我去{{c1::过::了 or 过?}}上海。
(A specific trip, yesterday) 我昨天去{{c1::了::了 or 过?}}上海。
tr: I've been to Shanghai. / I went to Shanghai yesterday.
notes: 过: experience (at some point, ever). 了: a specific completed action.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在
text: 门开{{c1::着::continuing state}}。
tr: The door is open.
notes: Verb + 着: an ongoing state (门开着 = the door is open), or the manner of another action (躺着看书 = read lying down).
tip: vs 正在: an action in progress, not a state.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在

text: 他喜欢躺{{c1::着::manner (while …ing)}}看书。

notes: Verb + 着: an ongoing state (门开着 = the door is open), or the manner of another action (躺着看书 = read lying down).
tip: vs 正在: an action in progress, not a state.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::01 Aspect: 过, 着, 正在

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 你听{{c1::懂::result: understood}}了吗？

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 我看{{c1::见::result: perceived (saw)}}他了。
tr: I saw him.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 饭做{{c1::好::result: done (properly)}}了，来吃吧。
tr: Dinner's ready — come and eat.
notes: Verb + result: 完 (finished), 懂 (understood), 见 (perceived: 看见, 听见), 到 (reached the goal: 找到, 买到), 好 (done properly), 错 (wrongly). Negative: 没 + verb + result.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 对不起，我写{{c1::错::result: wrongly}}了。
tr: Sorry, I wrote it wrong.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 我没听{{c1::懂::result: understood (negative)}}。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 他跑得{{c1::很快::fast (comment after 得)}}。

notes: Verb + 得 + comment: how something is done (说得很好). With an object, repeat the verb or put the object first: 他说汉语说得很好 / 他汉语说得很好.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text: 我昨天睡得{{c1::不好::not well (comment after 得)}}。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction
text:
(The speaker is inside) 请进{{c1::来::来 or 去?}}。
(The speaker is inside) 他刚出{{c2::去::来 or 去?}}。
tr: Please come in. / He's just gone out.
notes: Verb + 来: towards the speaker. Verb + 去: away from the speaker. 进来 (come in), 出去 (go out), 回来 (come back), 下来 (come down).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::02 Complements: result, degree (得), direction

text: 我学了两{{c1::年::year (duration)}}汉语。

text: 我等了你{{c1::半个小时::half an hour (duration)}}。
tr: I waited half an hour for you.
notes: Verb + (了) + duration: how long something lasted. With an object, either repeat the verb (学汉语学了两年) or put the duration before the object (学了两年汉语).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 我学汉语{{c1::学了::learn (repeated verb + 了)}}三年。
tr: I've been learning Chinese for three years.
notes: Verb + (了) + duration: how long something lasted. With an object, either repeat the verb (学汉语学了两年) or put the duration before the object (学了两年汉语).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 我去过中国两{{c1::次::measure word: times (occasions)}}。
tr: I've been to China twice.
notes: Verb + 过 / 了 + number + 次: (number of) times; occasions. 遍: times, from start to finish (reading, watching, saying something again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 这个电影我看了三{{c1::遍::measure word: times (start to finish)}}。
tr: I've watched this film three times.
notes: Verb + 过 / 了 + number + 次: (number of) times; occasions. 遍: times, from start to finish (reading, watching, saying something again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 请再说一{{c1::遍::measure word: times (start to finish)}}。
tr: Please say it again.
notes: Verb + 过 / 了 + number + 次: (number of) times; occasions. 遍: times, from start to finish (reading, watching, saying something again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 请等{{c1::一下::briefly (softens a request)}}。
tr: Please wait a moment.
notes: Verb + 一下: do briefly; softens a request (等一下, 看一下). Doubling the verb (看看, 试试, 休息休息) also means 'do a bit' and sounds casual.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 你看{{c1::一下::briefly (softens a request)}}这个。
tr: Take a look at this.
notes: Verb + 一下: do briefly; softens a request (等一下, 看一下). Doubling the verb (看看, 试试, 休息休息) also means 'do a bit' and sounds casual.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 我可以试{{c1::试::reduplication (do a bit)}}吗？
tr: Can I try it?
notes: Verb + 一下: do briefly; softens a request (等一下, 看一下). Doubling the verb (看看, 试试, 休息休息) also means 'do a bit' and sounds casual.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::03 Duration, frequency, 一下 and reduplication
text: 我们休息{{c1::休息::reduplication (do a bit)}}吧。
tr: Let's take a little break.
notes: Verb + 一下: do briefly; softens a request (等一下, 看一下). Doubling the verb (看看, 试试, 休息休息) also means 'do a bit' and sounds casual.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 今天{{c1::比::than (comparison)}}昨天冷。
tr: It's colder today than yesterday.
notes: A 比 B + adjective: A is more … than B. No 很 before the adjective. The difference goes after it: 高十厘米, 贵一点儿, 大三岁. 更 adds 'even more'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 他比我{{c1::高::tall (adjective after 比, no 很)}}。
tr: He's taller than me.
notes: A 比 B + adjective: A is more … than B. No 很 before the adjective. The difference goes after it: 高十厘米, 贵一点儿, 大三岁. 更 adds 'even more'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 哥哥比我大三{{c1::岁::years of age (the difference)}}。
tr: My brother is three years older than me.
notes: A 比 B + adjective: A is more … than B. No 很 before the adjective. The difference goes after it: 高十厘米, 贵一点儿, 大三岁. 更 adds 'even more'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 这个比那个贵{{c1::一点儿::a little (difference after the adjective)}}。
tr: This one's a bit more expensive than that one.
notes: A 比 B + adjective: A is more … than B. No 很 before the adjective. The difference goes after it: 高十厘米, 贵一点儿, 大三岁. 更 adds 'even more'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 这本书比那本{{c1::更::even more (after 比 B)}}有意思。
tr: This book is even more interesting than that one.
notes: A 比 B + adjective: A is more … than B. No 很 before the adjective. The difference goes after it: 高十厘米, 贵一点儿, 大三岁. 更 adds 'even more'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 我{{c1::没有::not as … as (negative comparison)}}他高。
tr: I'm not as tall as him.
notes: A 没有 B + adjective: A is not as … as B. A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective): A is the same as B (as … as).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 今天{{c1::没有::not as … as (negative comparison)}}昨天热。
tr: Today isn't as hot as yesterday.
notes: A 没有 B + adjective: A is not as … as B. A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective): A is the same as B (as … as).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 我的手机{{c1::跟::with / as (… 一样)}}你的一样。
tr: My phone is the same as yours.
notes: A 没有 B + adjective: A is not as … as B. A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective): A is the same as B (as … as).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: 她跟她妈妈{{c1::一样::the same (as)}}漂亮。
tr: She's as pretty as her mum.
notes: A 没有 B + adjective: A is not as … as B. A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective): A is the same as B (as … as).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text:
(Of everyone) 他是我们班{{c1::最::更 or 最?}}高的。
(Compared with me) 他比我{{c2::更::更 or 最?}}高。
tr: He's the tallest in our class. / He's even taller than me.
notes: 更: even more (comparing two). 最: the most (of all).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::04 Comparison: 比, 没有, 一样, 更, 最
text: (Of all seasons) 我{{c1::最::更 or 最?}}喜欢夏天。
tr: I like summer best.
notes: 更: even more (comparing two). 最: the most (of all).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你{{c1::是不是::A-not-A question (是)}}学生？
tr: Are you a student?
notes: Verb / adjective + 不 + the same verb / adjective makes a yes / no question (no 吗). 有 → 有没有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你明天{{c1::去不去::A-not-A question (去)}}？
tr: Are you going tomorrow?
notes: Verb / adjective + 不 + the same verb / adjective makes a yes / no question (no 吗). 有 → 有没有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 这个菜{{c1::好吃不好吃::A-not-A question (好吃)}}？
tr: Is this dish nice?
notes: Verb / adjective + 不 + the same verb / adjective makes a yes / no question (no 吗). 有 → 有没有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你{{c1::有没有::A-not-A question (有)}}时间？
tr: Do you have time?
notes: Verb / adjective + 不 + the same verb / adjective makes a yes / no question (no 吗). 有 → 有没有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text:
你喝茶{{c1::还是::还是 or 或者?}}咖啡？
茶{{c2::或者::还是 or 或者?}}咖啡都可以。
tr: Would you like tea or coffee? / Tea or coffee, either is fine.
notes: 还是: or (in a question, asking someone to choose). 或者: or (in a statement).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 我们周六{{c1::或者::还是 or 或者?}}周日去吧。
tr: Let's go on Saturday or Sunday.
notes: 还是: or (in a question, asking someone to choose). 或者: or (in a statement).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你是中国人{{c1::还是::还是 or 或者?}}日本人？
tr: Are you Chinese or Japanese?
notes: 还是: or (in a question, asking someone to choose). 或者: or (in a statement).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你{{c1::为什么::why}}不去？
tr: Why aren't you going?
notes: 为什么: why. 怎么 + verb: how (to do something); with surprise it means 'how come…?'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 你{{c1::怎么::how come (surprise)}}还没睡？
tr: How come you're still up?
notes: 为什么: why. 怎么 + verb: how (to do something); with surprise it means 'how come…?'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::05 Questions: A-不-A, 还是 vs 或者, 为什么 / 怎么
text: 去火车站{{c1::怎么::how}}走？
tr: How do I get to the station?
notes: 为什么: why. 怎么 + verb: how (to do something); with surprise it means 'how come…?'.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 你{{c1::是::focus frame, first part (… 的)}}什么时候来的？
tr: When did you get here?
notes: 是 … 的 stresses when, where, how or with whom a past action happened (the action itself is already known). 是 is often dropped in speech.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 我是坐飞机来{{c1::的::focus frame, second part (是 …)}}。
tr: I came by plane.
notes: 是 … 的 stresses when, where, how or with whom a past action happened (the action itself is already known). 是 is often dropped in speech.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 他是在北京出生{{c1::的::focus frame, second part (是 …)}}。
tr: He was born in Beijing.
notes: 是 … 的 stresses when, where, how or with whom a past action happened (the action itself is already known). 是 is often dropped in speech.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 我是跟朋友一起来{{c1::的::focus frame, second part (是 …)}}。
tr: I came with a friend.
notes: 是 … 的 stresses when, where, how or with whom a past action happened (the action itself is already known). 是 is often dropped in speech.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 火车{{c1::要::about to (… 了)}}开了。
tr: The train is about to leave.
notes: 要 / 快 / 快要 / 就要 … 了: about to; soon. With a specific time word, use 就要 (not 快要): 他明天就要走了.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: {{c1::快::nearly / soon (… 了)}}十二点了。
tr: It's nearly twelve.
notes: 要 / 快 / 快要 / 就要 … 了: about to; soon. With a specific time word, use 就要 (not 快要): 他明天就要走了.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 他明天{{c1::就要::about to (with a time word, … 了)}}走了。
tr: He's leaving tomorrow.
notes: 要 / 快 / 快要 / 就要 … 了: about to; soon. With a specific time word, use 就要 (not 快要): 他明天就要走了.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 我去商店{{c1::买::buy (second verb: purpose)}}东西。
tr: I'm going to the shop to buy some things.
notes: Subject + verb 1 (going somewhere, or the means) + verb 2 (the purpose): 去商店买东西 (go to the shop to buy things), 坐地铁上班 (take the underground to work).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 他坐地铁{{c1::上班::go to work (second verb)}}。
tr: He takes the underground to work.
notes: Subject + verb 1 (going somewhere, or the means) + verb 2 (the purpose): 去商店买东西 (go to the shop to buy things), 坐地铁上班 (take the underground to work).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 我们{{c1::去::go (first verb)}}饭店吃饭吧。
tr: Let's go to a restaurant to eat.
notes: Subject + verb 1 (going somewhere, or the means) + verb 2 (the purpose): 去商店买东西 (go to the shop to buy things), 坐地铁上班 (take the underground to work).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 妈妈{{c1::让::let / make / tell (someone to do)}}我早点儿回家。
tr: Mum told me to come home early.
notes: 让 / 叫 + person + verb: make / let / tell someone do something.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 老师{{c1::叫::tell (someone to do)}}我们写作业。
tr: The teacher told us to do our homework.
notes: 让 / 叫 + person + verb: make / let / tell someone do something.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::06 Sentence patterns: 是…的, 要…了, serial verbs, 让
text: 我不{{c1::让::let (someone do)}}他去。
tr: I won't let him go.
notes: 让 / 叫 + person + verb: make / let / tell someone do something.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text:
(In the future) 明天{{c1::再::再 or 又?}}来吧。
(It already happened) 他昨天{{c2::又::再 or 又?}}迟到了。
tr: Come again tomorrow. / He was late again yesterday.
notes: 再: again (in the future, or in a request: 请再说一遍). 又: again (it has already happened again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: (It's happened again) 你怎么{{c1::又::再 or 又?}}忘了？
tr: How come you've forgotten again?
notes: 再: again (in the future, or in a request: 请再说一遍). 又: again (it has already happened again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: (Next time) 我们下次{{c1::再::再 or 又?}}见。
tr: See you next time.
notes: 再: again (in the future, or in a request: 请再说一遍). 又: again (it has already happened again).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text:
(Early) 他六点{{c1::就::就 or 才?}}起床了。
(Late) 他十点{{c2::才::就 or 才?}}起床。
tr: He was up as early as six. / He didn't get up until ten.
notes: 就: as early as; as soon as (earlier or easier than expected; often with 了). 才: not until; only then (later or harder than expected; no 了).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: (Quick) 我一会儿{{c1::就::就 or 才?}}回来。
tr: I'll be right back.
notes: 就: as early as; as soon as (earlier or easier than expected; often with 了). 才: not until; only then (later or harder than expected; no 了).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: (Late) 你怎么现在{{c1::才::就 or 才?}}来？
tr: Why are you only getting here now?
notes: 就: as early as; as soon as (earlier or easier than expected; often with 了). 才: not until; only then (later or harder than expected; no 了).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 他{{c1::还::still}}在睡觉。
tr: He's still asleep.
notes: 还: still; also, in addition. 已经…了: already. 一直: all along; continuously. 马上: right away.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 我{{c1::已经::already}}吃饭了。
tr: I've already eaten.
notes: 还: still; also, in addition. 已经…了: already. 一直: all along; continuously. 马上: right away.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 我买了苹果，{{c1::还::also / in addition}}买了香蕉。
tr: I bought apples, and bananas too.
notes: 还: still; also, in addition. 已经…了: already. 一直: all along; continuously. 马上: right away.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 他{{c1::一直::all along / continuously}}在等你。
tr: He's been waiting for you the whole time.
notes: 还: still; also, in addition. 已经…了: already. 一直: all along; continuously. 马上: right away.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 我{{c1::马上::right away}}来。
tr: I'll be right there.
notes: 还: still; also, in addition. 已经…了: already. 一直: all along; continuously. 马上: right away.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: {{c1::别::don't}}说话！
tr: Don't talk!
notes: 别 + verb: don't (= 不要). 只: only (goes before the verb).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 你{{c1::别::don't}}担心。
tr: Don't worry.
notes: 别 + verb: don't (= 不要). 只: only (goes before the verb).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 我{{c1::只::only (before the verb)}}有十块钱。
tr: I only have ten yuan.
notes: 别 + verb: don't (= 不要). 只: only (goes before the verb).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::07 Adverbs: 再 / 又, 就 / 才, 还, 已经, 别, 只
text: 他{{c1::只::only (before the verb)}}喝水。
tr: He only drinks water.
notes: 别 + verb: don't (= 不要). 只: only (goes before the verb).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 我{{c1::从::from}}八点到十二点上课。
tr: I have classes from eight to twelve.
notes: 从 (from) … 到 (to / until): for places and times.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 从北京{{c1::到::to}}上海要几个小时？
tr: How many hours is it from Beijing to Shanghai?
notes: 从 (from) … 到 (to / until): for places and times.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 你是{{c1::从::from}}哪儿来的？
tr: Where are you from?
notes: 从 (from) … 到 (to / until): for places and times.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 我家{{c1::离::from (distance)}}学校很近。
tr: My home is close to the school.
notes: A 离 B + 远 / 近: A is far from / near B. Also for time: 离考试还有三天 (there are three days to go until the exam).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 机场离这儿{{c1::远::far}}吗？
tr: Is the airport far from here?
notes: A 离 B + 远 / 近: A is far from / near B. Also for time: 离考试还有三天 (there are three days to go until the exam).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: {{c1::离::until (time distance)}}考试还有三天。
tr: There are three days to go until the exam.
notes: A 离 B + 远 / 近: A is far from / near B. Also for time: 离考试还有三天 (there are three days to go until the exam).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 一直{{c1::往::towards}}前走。
tr: Go straight ahead.
notes: 往: towards (往前走 = go straight ahead). 对: to / towards (an attitude: 对我很好), or good / bad for (对身体不好). 给: to / for (给你打电话 = call you).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给
text: 她{{c1::对::to / towards (attitude)}}我很好。
tr: She's very kind to me.
notes: 往: towards (往前走 = go straight ahead). 对: to / towards (an attitude: 对我很好), or good / bad for (对身体不好). 给: to / for (给你打电话 = call you).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::08 Prepositions: 从…到, 离, 往, 对, 给

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

tr: Because it was raining, I didn't go.
notes: 因为 … 所以 …: because … (so) … — Chinese often uses both together.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越
text: 因为我病了，{{c1::所以::so}}没上班。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::09 Linking words: 因为…所以, 但是, 如果…就, 先…然后, 越来越

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿

notes: 每 + measure word + noun: every; often with 都 before the verb (每个人都…). 每天, 每年 need no measure word.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿

tr: Some people like tea; others like coffee.
notes: 别的: other. 大家: everyone. 自己: oneself; (by) myself. 有的 … 有的 …: some …, others …

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text: 这是我{{c1::第::ordinal prefix}}一次来中国。
tr: This is my first time in China.
notes: 第 + number: ordinal (第一, 第二次). number + 多 + measure word: more than; -odd (二十多个 = twenty-odd). 半: half — 半个小时 (half an hour), 一个半小时 (an hour and a half).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text: 我们班有二十{{c1::多::more than (… -odd)}}个学生。
tr: There are twenty-odd students in our class.
notes: 第 + number: ordinal (第一, 第二次). number + 多 + measure word: more than; -odd (二十多个 = twenty-odd). 半: half — 半个小时 (half an hour), 一个半小时 (an hour and a half).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text: 我等了一个{{c1::半::half (after the measure word)}}小时。
tr: I waited an hour and a half.
notes: 第 + number: ordinal (第一, 第二次). number + 多 + measure word: more than; -odd (二十多个 = twenty-odd). 半: half — 半个小时 (half an hour), 一个半小时 (an hour and a half).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text:
(A complaint) 这个{{c1::有一点儿::一点儿 or 有一点儿?}}贵。
(A request) 能便宜{{c2::一点儿::一点儿 or 有一点儿?}}吗？
tr: This is a bit expensive. / Could you make it a bit cheaper?
notes: Adjective + 一点儿: a bit more (comparing, or in a request: 便宜一点儿). 有一点儿 + adjective: a bit (usually something negative: 有一点儿贵).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text: (How you feel) 我今天{{c1::有一点儿::一点儿 or 有一点儿?}}累。
tr: I'm a bit tired today.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK2::10 每, 别的, 自己, 第, 多, 半, 一点儿
text: (A request) 请说慢{{c1::一点儿::一点儿 or 有一点儿?}}。
tr: Please speak a bit more slowly.
notes: Adjective + 一点儿: a bit more (comparing, or in a request: 便宜一点儿). 有一点儿 + adjective: a bit (usually something negative: 有一点儿贵).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 我{{c1::把::object marker (moves the object before the verb)}}作业写完了。
tr: I've finished my homework.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 请{{c1::把::object marker}}门关上。
tr: Please shut the door.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 他把钱放{{c1::在::in / at (after the verb, + place)}}包里了。
tr: He put the money in his bag.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 我把书还{{c1::给::to (after the verb, + person)}}老师了。

notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 你{{c1::别把::don't + object marker}}手机忘在家里。
tr: Don't leave your phone at home.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 我{{c1::没把::didn't + object marker}}这件事告诉他。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 请把这句话翻译{{c1::成::into (result: become)}}英文。
tr: Please translate this sentence into English.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 他把杯子打{{c1::破::result: broken}}了。
tr: He broke the cup.
notes: Subject + 把 + object (a specific, known thing) + verb + something extra: 了, a result (写完), a direction (关上), or 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 + place / person / result. Negatives and modal verbs go before 把: 没把, 别把, 要把.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 我的自行车{{c1::被::passive marker}}偷了。
tr: My bike's been stolen.
notes: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + something extra (了, a result). Often for unpleasant events. Colloquial: 让 / 叫 (the doer must be named). Negative: 没被.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 他{{c1::被::passive marker}}老师批评了。
tr: He got told off by the teacher.
notes: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + something extra (了, a result). Often for unpleasant events. Colloquial: 让 / 叫 (the doer must be named). Negative: 没被.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 蛋糕被弟弟吃{{c1::完::result: finished}}了。
tr: The cake was all eaten by my little brother.
notes: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + something extra (了, a result). Often for unpleasant events. Colloquial: 让 / 叫 (the doer must be named). Negative: 没被.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 我的钱包{{c1::让::passive marker (colloquial, doer needed)}}小偷偷走了。
tr: My wallet was nicked by a thief.
notes: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + something extra (了, a result). Often for unpleasant events. Colloquial: 让 / 叫 (the doer must be named). Negative: 没被.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text: 他{{c1::没被::not + passive marker}}选上。
tr: He wasn't selected.
notes: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb + something extra (了, a result). Often for unpleasant events. Colloquial: 让 / 叫 (the doer must be named). Negative: 没被.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::01 把 and 被
text:
弟弟{{c1::把::把 or 被?}}蛋糕吃了。
蛋糕{{c2::被::把 or 被?}}弟弟吃了。
tr: My little brother ate the cake. / The cake was eaten by my little brother.
notes: 把: the doer is the subject (doer 把 thing + verb). 被: the thing affected is the subject (thing 被 doer + verb).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::02 Potential complements (听得懂 / 听不懂)

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::02 Potential complements (听得懂 / 听不懂)

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::02 Potential complements (听得懂 / 听不懂)

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::02 Potential complements (听得懂 / 听不懂)

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::02 Potential complements (听得懂 / 听不懂)
text:
(Too difficult to understand) 这本书我{{c1::看不懂::看不懂 or 不能看?}}。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::05 Linking words: 虽然, 不但, 一边, 一…就, 只要 / 只有

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::05 Linking words: 虽然, 不但, 一边, 一…就, 只要 / 只有
text:
{{c1::只要::只要 or 只有?}}努力，就能学好。
{{c2::只有::只要 or 只有?}}努力，才能学好。
tr: As long as you work hard, you'll learn it. / Only by working hard can you learn it.
notes: 只要 … 就: as long as (this is enough). 只有 … 才: only if (this is the one necessary condition).
tip: The second word gives a clue: 就 goes with 只要; 才 goes with 只有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::05 Linking words: 虽然, 不但, 一边, 一…就, 只要 / 只有

tip: The second word gives a clue: 就 goes with 只要; 才 goes with 只有.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::05 Linking words: 虽然, 不但, 一边, 一…就, 只要 / 只有

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::06 Linking words: 除了, 连, 越…越, 要是, 不是…就是
text:

notes: 除了 … 以外, 还 / 也 …: besides; in addition to (adding). 除了 … 以外, 都 …: except (leaving out).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::06 Linking words: 除了, 连, 越…越, 要是, 不是…就是

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK3::08 Adverbs and duration of not doing
text:

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::01 Concession and conditions: 不管, 即使, 既然, 尽管, 否则, 除非
text: {{c1::不管::no matter (colloquial)}}天气怎么样，我们都要去。
tr: Whatever the weather, we're going.
notes: 不管 / 无论 + question word, A-不-A, or A 还是 B, + 都 / 也: no matter what / how / whether… 无论 is more formal.
tip: vs 即使: 即使 introduces one hypothetical case.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::01 Concession and conditions: 不管, 即使, 既然, 尽管, 否则, 除非

tip: vs 即使: 即使 introduces one hypothetical case.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::01 Concession and conditions: 不管, 即使, 既然, 尽管, 否则, 除非

tr: Whether you go or not, I'm going.
notes: 不管 / 无论 + question word, A-不-A, or A 还是 B, + 都 / 也: no matter what / how / whether… 无论 is more formal.
tip: vs 即使: 即使 introduces one hypothetical case.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::01 Concession and conditions: 不管, 即使, 既然, 尽管, 否则, 除非

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::01 Concession and conditions: 不管, 即使, 既然, 尽管, 否则, 除非

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::02 Contrast and attitude adverbs: 却, 并, 竟然, 难道, 反而…
text: 他很努力，成绩{{c1::却::yet (unexpected contrast, after the subject)}}不好。

(a rhetorical question). 到底: on earth (in questions). 毕竟: after all. 反而: on the contrary; instead. 简直: simply; practically.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::03 More adverbs: 尤其, 原来, 恐怕, 果然; 往往 vs 常常
text: 我喜欢水果，{{c1::尤其::especially}}是苹果。
tr: I like fruit, especially apples.
notes: 尤其 (是): especially. 原来: so it turns out (realising something). 恐怕: I'm afraid; probably (something unwelcome). 果然: just as expected. 偶尔: occasionally.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::03 More adverbs: 尤其, 原来, 恐怕, 果然; 往往 vs 常常

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::03 More adverbs: 尤其, 原来, 恐怕, 果然; 往往 vs 常常
text:
(A request) 你要{{c1::常常::常常 or 往往?}}来看我。
(A pattern) 周末他{{c2::往往::常常 or 往往?}}睡到中午。
tr: Do come and see me often. / At weekends he tends to sleep until noon.
notes: 常常: often (any time, including the future, wishes and requests). 往往: tends to (a regular pattern under certain conditions, in the past or present; not for the future or requests).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::04 Formal prepositions: 关于 / 对于, 由于, 随着, 按照, 通过
text:
这是一本{{c1::关于::关于 or 对于?}}中国历史的书。
他{{c2::对于::关于 or 对于?}}工作非常认真。
tr: This is a book about Chinese history. / He's very conscientious about his work.
notes: 关于: about (the topic; can begin a title: 关于中国的书). 对于: regarding; towards (the target of an attitude or treatment).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::04 Formal prepositions: 关于 / 对于, 由于, 随着, 按照, 通过
text: {{c1::由于::due to (formal)}}天气不好，航班取消了。
tr: The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
notes: 由于: due to; because of (formal). 随着: along with; as (something changes). 按照: according to (rules, instructions). 根据: according to; based on (data, sources). 通过: through; by means of.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::04 Formal prepositions: 关于 / 对于, 由于, 随着, 按照, 通过
text: {{c1::随着::along with (as … changes)}}经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好。
tr: As the economy grows, people's lives keep getting better.
notes: 由于: due to; because of (formal). 随着: along with; as (something changes). 按照: according to (rules, instructions). 根据: according to; based on (data, sources). 通过: through; by means of.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::05 Causing and purpose: 使 / 令, 为了 vs 因为, 由
text: 这个消息{{c1::使::使 or 令?}}我很高兴。
tr: This news made me very happy.
notes: 使 / 令 + person + verb / adjective: make; cause (more formal than 让). 令人 + adjective is a fixed pattern: 令人感动 (moving), 令人失望 (disappointing).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::05 Causing and purpose: 使 / 令, 为了 vs 因为, 由
text: 这部电影{{c1::令::使 or 令?}}人感动。
tr: This film is very moving.
notes: 使 / 令 + person + verb / adjective: make; cause (more formal than 让). 令人 + adjective is a fixed pattern: 令人感动 (moving), 令人失望 (disappointing).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::05 Causing and purpose: 使 / 令, 为了 vs 因为, 由
text:
(Purpose) {{c1::为了::为了 or 因为?}}学好汉语，他每天练习。
(Cause) {{c2::因为::为了 or 因为?}}生病，他没来上课。
tr: To learn Chinese well, he practises every day. / He missed class because he was ill.
notes: 为了: in order to; for (a purpose). 因为: because (a cause).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::05 Causing and purpose: 使 / 令, 为了 vs 因为, 由
text: 这个项目{{c1::由::by (responsible party)}}他负责。
tr: He's in charge of this project.
notes: 由 + person + verb: by (who is responsible for doing it; formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::05 Causing and purpose: 使 / 令, 为了 vs 因为, 由

tr: The meeting will be chaired by Manager Wang.
notes: 由 + person + verb: by (who is responsible for doing it; formal).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::06 Formal linking words: 以及, 而, 于是, 因此, 总之, 首先
text: 桌子、椅子{{c1::以及::as well as (written list)}}其他家具都很新。
tr: The tables, chairs and other furniture are all new.
notes: 以及: and; as well as (written lists). 而: whereas; and (contrast). 于是: so; and then (what happened next). 因此: therefore. 总之: in short. 首先 / 其次 / 最后: first / secondly / finally.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::06 Formal linking words: 以及, 而, 于是, 因此, 总之, 首先

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::07 Structures: 来 + purpose, 是否, 不得不, 不仅, 一方面

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK4::08 Quantity and time: 左右, 以上, 之一, 之间, 以来

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::01 Preference: 与其…不如, 宁可…也
text: {{c1::与其::rather than (first part)}}在家看电视，不如出去走走。
tr: Rather than watching TV at home, we'd be better off going out for a walk.
notes: 与其 A, 不如 B: rather than A, it's better to B (you recommend B).
tip: vs 宁可 … 也不: says what you yourself would rather do.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::01 Preference: 与其…不如, 宁可…也

notes: 与其 A, 不如 B: rather than A, it's better to B (you recommend B).
tip: vs 宁可 … 也不: says what you yourself would rather do.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::01 Preference: 与其…不如, 宁可…也

notes: 宁可 / 宁愿 A, 也不 B: would rather A than B (A is a sacrifice you'll accept).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::01 Preference: 与其…不如, 宁可…也

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::03 Purpose and avoidance: 以便, 以免, 免得
text:
请留下电话号码，{{c1::以便::以便 or 以免?}}我们联系你。
出门带把伞，{{c2::以免::以便 or 以免?}}被雨淋。
tr: Please leave your number so that we can contact you. / Take an umbrella so you don't get soaked.
notes: 以便: so that; in order to (make something easier; formal). 以免: so as to avoid (something bad; formal). Colloquial equivalent of 以免: 免得.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::03 Purpose and avoidance: 以便, 以免, 免得

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::04 Hypotheses and concession: 假如, 万一, 即便, 固然

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::06 Formal verb frames: 加以, 予以, 进行, 受到, 作为, 为…所
text: 这个问题需要{{c1::加以::apply (+ two-syllable verb)}}研究。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::07 Written linking words: 便, 即, 从而, 此外, 由此可见
text: 他吃完饭{{c1::便::then (written 就)}}出去了。
tr: After eating, he went straight out.
notes: 便: then; right away (written 就). 即: that is; namely (formal). 从而: thus; thereby. 此外: in addition. 总而言之: in a word; all in all. 由此可见: from this we can see. 换句话说: in other words.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::07 Written linking words: 便, 即, 从而, 此外, 由此可见
text: 中国的首都{{c1::即::namely (formal)}}北京。

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::08 Correlatives: 一旦, 凡是, 无非, 不是…而是, 与其说…不如说
text: {{c1::一旦::once (… 就)}}决定了，就不要改变。
tr: Once you've decided, don't change your mind.
notes: 一旦 … 就: once (something happens). 凡是 … 都: all; every (without exception). 无非: nothing but; simply. 不是 A, 而是 B: not A, but B (correcting). 与其说 A, 不如说 B: it's not so much A as B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::08 Correlatives: 一旦, 凡是, 无非, 不是…而是, 与其说…不如说
text: {{c1::凡是::all / every (… 都)}}参加的人都可以得到礼物。
tr: Everyone who takes part gets a present.
notes: 一旦 … 就: once (something happens). 凡是 … 都: all; every (without exception). 无非: nothing but; simply. 不是 A, 而是 B: not A, but B (correcting). 与其说 A, 不如说 B: it's not so much A as B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::08 Correlatives: 一旦, 凡是, 无非, 不是…而是, 与其说…不如说
text: 他说的{{c1::无非::nothing but}}是一些客套话。
tr: What he said was just polite talk.
notes: 一旦 … 就: once (something happens). 凡是 … 都: all; every (without exception). 无非: nothing but; simply. 不是 A, 而是 B: not A, but B (correcting). 与其说 A, 不如说 B: it's not so much A as B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::08 Correlatives: 一旦, 凡是, 无非, 不是…而是, 与其说…不如说

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK5::08 Correlatives: 一旦, 凡是, 无非, 不是…而是, 与其说…不如说
text: 与其说他是老师，{{c1::不如说::it's more that (second part)}}他是朋友。
tr: He's not so much a teacher as a friend.
notes: 一旦 … 就: once (something happens). 凡是 … 都: all; every (without exception). 无非: nothing but; simply. 不是 A, 而是 B: not A, but B (correcting). 与其说 A, 不如说 B: it's not so much A as B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::01 Literary questions and surprise: 岂, 何尝, 莫非, 不料, 未免
text: 这样做{{c1::岂::how could (rhetorical; + 不是)}}不是浪费时间？
tr: Wouldn't doing it this way just waste time?
notes: 岂 (+ 不是 …?): how could…?; wouldn't that be…? (rhetorical). 何尝: when have I ever… (= never; or 'it's not that I don't…'). 莫非: could it be that…? (a worried guess).
tip: vs 难道 (HSK 4): the everyday rhetorical question.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::01 Literary questions and surprise: 岂, 何尝, 莫非, 不料, 未免
text: 我{{c1::何尝::when have I ever (= it's not that I don't)}}不想去，只是没有时间。
tr: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have time.
notes: 岂 (+ 不是 …?): how could…?; wouldn't that be…? (rhetorical). 何尝: when have I ever… (= never; or 'it's not that I don't…'). 莫非: could it be that…? (a worried guess).
tip: vs 难道 (HSK 4): the everyday rhetorical question.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::01 Literary questions and surprise: 岂, 何尝, 莫非, 不料, 未免
text: 他还没来，{{c1::莫非::could it be that}}出了什么事？
tr: He's still not here — could something have happened?
notes: 岂 (+ 不是 …?): how could…?; wouldn't that be…? (rhetorical). 何尝: when have I ever… (= never; or 'it's not that I don't…'). 莫非: could it be that…? (a worried guess).
tip: vs 难道 (HSK 4): the everyday rhetorical question.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::01 Literary questions and surprise: 岂, 何尝, 莫非, 不料, 未免
text: 本来想去爬山，{{c1::不料::unexpectedly}}下起了大雨。
tr: We meant to go hiking, but it unexpectedly started pouring.
notes: 不料: unexpectedly; to everyone's surprise (something went differently from the plan). 未免 (+ 太 … 了): rather too…; a bit much (a tactful criticism).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::01 Literary questions and surprise: 岂, 何尝, 莫非, 不料, 未免
text: 你这样说{{c1::未免::rather (too …, tactful criticism)}}太过分了。
tr: Saying that is going a bit too far.
notes: 不料: unexpectedly; to everyone's surprise (something went differently from the plan). 未免 (+ 太 … 了): rather too…; a bit much (a tactful criticism).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::02 Result and degree: 以至于, 以致, 毫无, 丝毫
text: 他太专心了，{{c1::以至于::to the point that (any result)}}没听见有人叫他。
tr: He was so absorbed that he didn't hear someone calling him.
notes: 以至于: to the point that (any result). 以致: resulting in (usually a bad result).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::02 Result and degree: 以至于, 以致, 毫无, 丝毫
text: 他平时不努力，{{c1::以致::resulting in (a bad result)}}考试没通过。
tr: He never put in the effort, and as a result he failed the exam.
notes: 以至于: to the point that (any result). 以致: resulting in (usually a bad result).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::02 Result and degree: 以至于, 以致, 毫无, 丝毫
text: {{c1::毫无::not the slightest (+ noun)}}疑问，他是最好的。
tr: Without a doubt, he's the best.
notes: 毫无 + noun: not the slightest (毫无疑问 = without a doubt). 丝毫 + 不 / 没 + verb: not in the least.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::02 Result and degree: 以至于, 以致, 毫无, 丝毫
text: 他{{c1::丝毫::(not) in the least (+ 没 / 不)}}没有感到害怕。
tr: He wasn't the least bit afraid.
notes: 毫无 + noun: not the slightest (毫无疑问 = without a doubt). 丝毫 + 不 / 没 + verb: not in the least.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::03 Grounds: 鉴于, 基于, 本着, 出于, 凭
text: {{c1::鉴于::in view of (official)}}天气原因，比赛推迟。
tr: In view of the weather, the match is postponed.
notes: 鉴于: in view of (official). 基于: based on. 本着 … 的原则 / 精神: in line with (a principle). 出于: out of (a motive: 出于好奇). 凭: relying on; by virtue of (凭经验, 凭努力).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::03 Grounds: 鉴于, 基于, 本着, 出于, 凭
text: 这个结论是{{c1::基于::based on}}大量数据得出的。
tr: This conclusion is based on a large amount of data.
notes: 鉴于: in view of (official). 基于: based on. 本着 … 的原则 / 精神: in line with (a principle). 出于: out of (a motive: 出于好奇). 凭: relying on; by virtue of (凭经验, 凭努力).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::03 Grounds: 鉴于, 基于, 本着, 出于, 凭
text: {{c1::本着::in line with (a principle)}}互利的原则，双方签订了合同。

notes: 鉴于: in view of (official). 基于: based on. 本着 … 的原则 / 精神: in line with (a principle). 出于: out of (a motive: 出于好奇). 凭: relying on; by virtue of (凭经验, 凭努力).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::03 Grounds: 鉴于, 基于, 本着, 出于, 凭
text: 他{{c1::出于::out of (a motive)}}好奇打开了盒子。
tr: He opened the box out of curiosity.
notes: 鉴于: in view of (official). 基于: based on. 本着 … 的原则 / 精神: in line with (a principle). 出于: out of (a motive: 出于好奇). 凭: relying on; by virtue of (凭经验, 凭努力).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::03 Grounds: 鉴于, 基于, 本着, 出于, 凭
text: 他{{c1::凭::relying on}}自己的努力考上了大学。
tr: He got into university through his own hard work.
notes: 鉴于: in view of (official). 基于: based on. 本着 … 的原则 / 精神: in line with (a principle). 出于: out of (a motive: 出于好奇). 凭: relying on; by virtue of (凭经验, 凭努力).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::04 Attitude adverbs: 不惜, 务必, 姑且, 势必, 索性, 偏偏, 历来
text: 他{{c1::不惜::not hesitate (at any cost)}}一切代价也要成功。
tr: He's determined to succeed at any cost.
notes: 不惜: not hesitate to; at the cost of. 务必: must; be sure to (formal requests). 姑且: for the time being; tentatively. 势必: bound to (a trend). 索性: might as well (a decisive switch). 偏偏: of all things; just (contrary to what you wanted). 历来: always; historically.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 这本书写的是中国{{c1::之::classical 的 (formal)}}美。
tr: This book is about the beauty of China.
notes: 之: the classical 的, used in formal or fixed phrases (中国之美, 成功之路). 之所以 A, 是因为 B: the reason (why) A is B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 他{{c1::之所以::the reason why (… 是因为)}}成功，是因为他很努力。
tr: The reason he succeeded is that he worked hard.
notes: 之: the classical 的, used in formal or fixed phrases (中国之美, 成功之路). 之所以 A, 是因为 B: the reason (why) A is B.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 我们去了很多城市，{{c1::其中::among them}}我最喜欢的是西安。
tr: We went to lots of cities; my favourite of them was Xi'an.
notes: 其: his / her / its / their (formal; refers back to something just mentioned). 其中: among them. 及其: and its / their.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 这家公司及{{c1::其::its (formal)}}员工都很支持这个计划。
tr: The company and its staff all support the plan.
notes: 其: his / her / its / their (formal; refers back to something just mentioned). 其中: among them. 及其: and its / their.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 我{{c1::所::what (+ verb, formal)}}知道的就这些。
tr: That's all I know.
notes: 所 + verb (+ 的): what is (verbed); the thing that… (我所知道的 = what I know). Formal.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 这是大家{{c1::所::what (+ verb, formal)}}关心的问题。
tr: This is the issue everyone cares about.
notes: 所 + verb (+ 的): what is (verbed); the thing that… (我所知道的 = what I know). Formal.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 苹果和香蕉，我更喜欢{{c1::后者::前者 or 后者?}}。
tr: Apples or bananas — I prefer the latter (bananas).
notes: 者: the one (who / which); a person who (读者 = reader). 前者: the former. 后者: the latter.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::05 Classical function words: 之, 其, 所, 者
text: 工作和家庭，他总是把{{c1::前者::前者 or 后者?}}放在第一位。
tr: Work and family — he always puts the former (work) first.
notes: 者: the one (who / which); a person who (读者 = reader). 前者: the former. 后者: the latter.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: 我喜欢城市，他{{c1::则::whereas (written)}}喜欢农村。
tr: I like the city, whereas he likes the countryside.
notes: 则: whereas; then (contrast, written). 亦: also (literary 也). 皆: all (literary 都; 人人皆知). 乃: is; be (literary 是; 失败乃成功之母). 与: and; with (formal 和 / 跟).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: 我{{c1::亦::also (literary 也)}}有同感。
tr: I feel the same way.
notes: 则: whereas; then (contrast, written). 亦: also (literary 也). 皆: all (literary 都; 人人皆知). 乃: is; be (literary 是; 失败乃成功之母). 与: and; with (formal 和 / 跟).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: 这件事人人{{c1::皆::all (literary 都)}}知。
tr: Everyone knows about this.
notes: 则: whereas; then (contrast, written). 亦: also (literary 也). 皆: all (literary 都; 人人皆知). 乃: is; be (literary 是; 失败乃成功之母). 与: and; with (formal 和 / 跟).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: (Proverb) 失败{{c1::乃::is (literary 是)}}成功之母。
tr: Failure is the mother of success.
notes: 则: whereas; then (contrast, written). 亦: also (literary 也). 皆: all (literary 都; 人人皆知). 乃: is; be (literary 是; 失败乃成功之母). 与: and; with (formal 和 / 跟).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: 我{{c1::与::and / with (formal 和)}}他是多年的老朋友。
tr: He and I have been friends for many years.
notes: 则: whereas; then (contrast, written). 亦: also (literary 也). 皆: all (literary 都; 人人皆知). 乃: is; be (literary 是; 失败乃成功之母). 与: and; with (formal 和 / 跟).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为
text: 这座城市位{{c1::于::at (formal, 位 …)}}长江边。
tr: The city lies on the Yangtze.
notes: 于: at; in; to; than (formal): 位于 (located at), 大于 (greater than), 有利于 (beneficial to). 以 A 为 B: take A as B (以学生为中心 = student-centred).

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK6::06 Classical function words: 则, 亦, 皆, 乃, 与, 于, 以…为

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK7-9::09 Involuntary reactions and impossibility: 不禁, 不由得, 毫不 vs 毫无, 无可, 难以

他{{c1::毫不::毫不 or 毫无?}}犹豫地答应了。
这件事{{c2::毫无::毫不 or 毫无?}}意义。
tr: He agreed without the slightest hesitation. / This is completely meaningless.
notes: 不禁: couldn't help (written). 不由得: couldn't help (spoken). 毫不 + verb / adjective: not in the least. 毫无 + noun: without any. 无可 + two-syllable verb: cannot be (无可否认 = undeniable). 难以 + two-syllable verb: hard to (formal 很难).
tip: 毫不 takes a verb or adjective; 毫无 takes a noun.

tip: 毫不 takes a verb or adjective; 毫无 takes a noun.

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::HSK7-9::10 Classical particles in modern prose: 以, 于, 者, 何以, 而已

deck: Cloze Grammar::Chinese::Beyond HSK::05 Common learner errors

tr: As a child I often went to the park.
notes: No 了 for habitual past (常常去). 学会 / 听见 / 找到: the result, not just the attempt. 帮 + person (帮帮忙 is separable). 跟 … 结婚, 对 … 感兴趣. 非常 before the verb. 为 (happy for), 对 (good for). 还 + 要: another; more. 多 goes after 一个 + MW but before the MW with round numbers (一个多小时 / 十多个人). Time and place go before the verb.

notes: No 了 for habitual past (常常去). 学会 / 听见 / 找到: the result, not just the attempt. 帮 + person (帮帮忙 is separable). 跟 … 结婚, 对 … 感兴趣. 非常 before the verb. 为 (happy for), 对 (good for). 还 + 要: another; more. 多 goes after 一个 + MW but before the MW with round numbers (一个多小时 / 十多个人). Time and place go before the verb.
